messages:
Noah (support): alert from ACME-Integrations — sudden tail latency spike ~11:24 UTC. p95 went from ~140ms to ~2.4s; p99 at ~9s; ~8% 504s. Customer sample + trace: tenant=acme-int-02, trace=tx-9f1a. They report spike affects both hosted and their dedicated pool. Can oncall pick this up? :urg: 

Priya (oncall): I'm on. Drop example payload + any recent deploy info. I'll pull per-tenant panels and tracing.

Noah (support): Sample (sanitized): `{ "input": "<long customer doc>", "max_tokens": 700, "stream": false }`. No recent deploys on tenant side.

notif-bot: Alert firing: service=redwood-api, metric=tail_latency.p99, value=9.2s (window=5m). route=/v1/generate.

Priya (oncall): Looking at grafana: https://grafana.redwood/tenant-latency/acme-int-02. p95 jump at 11:23:12. No global deploys; control plane push at 11:20 (config only). Notable: per-tenant KV cache miss ratio spiked x6; pool-quant GPU driver restarts logged; queue depth on pool-quant increased.

Omar (sre): I see kernel resets on nodes in pool-quant-us-west. Also many long-running sync requests for this tenant. Cache misses look correlated with a custom header they send `X-Correlation-RunId` which is unique per request.

Jun (runtime): Logs from serving-layer: ```[2026-04-02T11:23:15Z] runtime: quant-kernel fallback for layer 12, slow-path engaged; req=... [2026-04-02T11:23:17Z] gpu-driver: soft-reset triggered on node-012; [2026-04-02T11:23:20Z] runtime: thread-pool starved, queue-depth=123```. Looks like chronic fallback to CPU path combined with long, non-streamed 700 token requests causing head-of-line blocking.

Priya (oncall): Proposed playbook (fast mitigation order): 1) apply short-term tenant concurrency cap; 2) force-fallback routing to a non-quantized / smaller model in a different region; 3) apply header-strip to improve cache; 4) enable streaming enforcement for requests >256 tokens; 5) if node drivers still stuck, reboot node group. Thoughts?

Omar (sre): Agreed. Non-disruptive first. I'll apply dynamic caps via quotas engine: `tenant=acme-int-02 concurrency=5 qps=10 duration=20m`.

infra-bot: Running: `quotactl set --tenant acme-int-02 --concurrency 5 --qps 10 --ttl 20m` -> OK.

Jun (runtime): Routing override ready: `routectl set --tenant acme-int-02 --route /v1/generate --model redwood-stable-small --region us-east-1 --weight 100 --note 'tail-latency mitigation'`. Applying now.

infra-bot: Routing change applied; propagation expected <45s.

Priya (oncall): Also apply header strip for noisy header, Omar? That should boost cache hits.

Omar (sre): Patch edge: `edgectl strip-headers --tenant acme-int-02 --headers X-Correlation-RunId,X-Client-Nonce --ttl 30m` -> applied. Cache miss rate down ~55% in 60s.

notif-bot: Update: tail_latency.p99 for tenant acme-int-02 decreased to 420ms (window=5m). Alert -> RESOLVED at 2026-04-02T11:28:07Z.

Noah (support): Customer reports much improved latency and far fewer errors. They had one in-flight big request that timed out but overall good.

Priya (oncall): Good. Documenting followups: 1) incident created and assigned (INC-2026-0784); 2) add automated guardrail: when tenant p95 > 1s for 2m -> auto-route to fallback model + apply soft concurrency cap; 3) add per-tenant circuit-breaker policy to return 429 when queue-depth > threshold; 4) update onboarding docs to recommend streaming >256 tokens and set default soft caps for new tenants; 5) capture repro and kernel logs.

Jun (runtime): I'll take kernel debug. Early repro in staging: non-streamed 700-token requests with concurrency 6 reproduce fallback to slow-path and GPU scheduler stalls. I'll collect GPU traces and open runtime PR with a regression case and mitigation patch (reduce slow-path penalty / delay fallback if possible).

Omar (sre): I'll open INC-2026-0784 and attach dashboards, logs, and the commands I ran. Also creating a new alert: `tenant_cache_miss_xbaseline > 3 AND p95>1s` to preemptively page.

Priya (oncall): For the guardrail config spec we should include: `auto_fallback: enabled=true, fallback_model=redwood-stable-small, trigger=(p95>1s for 2m OR p99>3s for 1m), action=(route 100% fallback, throttle concurrency to 5, send customer-notice)`. Can we stage this for new tenants by default and admin-opt-in for existing?

Omar (sre): Yes, we can. I'll implement staged rollout: default=true for new_tenants, admin-opt-in for existing. Also adding an exponential backoff circuit-breaker implementation: 429 -> 1s retry; 2nd over-limit -> 2s; 3rd -> 4s, etc., with decay after 5m.

infra-bot: Incident INC-2026-0784 created and assigned to runtime (Jun) and SRE (Omar).

Noah (support): Customer asks for root-cause timeline + what we changed. I'll wait for runtime RCA before sending.

Jun (runtime): Captured driver logs, core dumps, and a reproducible test. Plan: 1) add regression test to CI for long non-streamed sequences; 2) investigate quant-kernel fallback threshold and reduce overhead of slow-path; 3) consider a temporary conservative disable of quant path for sequences >512 until fix. Will open PR and link incident.

Priya (oncall): Quick notes for ops: runbook additions: - auto-enforce streaming for payloads >256 tokens (soft warning then mandatory) - per-tenant short-window p99 (1m) alerting for high-SLA tiers - default per-tenant soft caps on signup - header-normalization presets for common noisy headers.

Omar (sre): Also adding dashboard panels: per-tenant queue depth, fallback-routing-events, per-tenant cache miss ratio. Tweak alerts to page on short-window p99 for top-tier tenants.

Priya (oncall): We'll monitor for 45m; if no regressions, close incident. Thanks team.

Noah (support): I'll queue the customer update draft and hold until we have RCA details. :thumbsup: 

Jun (runtime): Opening runtime PR with repro and initial mitigation. Link: https://git.internal/runtime/pull/4321.

Omar (sre): Filed TKT-2026-150 alerting + ONB-2026-29 onboarding doc updates.

Priya (oncall): Thread will remain pinned to INC-2026-0784. Closing chat for now. Reach out on the incident for follow-ups.
